items.title: 独家解读｜AI编程“三巨头”，为何走了三家车企的路？
items.raw_excerpt: 谁能想到在同一天，三家AI编程巨头竟集体亮剑： Grok Build 公测、Everything Claude Code 登顶 GitHub、Codex 密集迭代更新。 “虽然都是AI编程工具，御三家的侧重点还是很不同的。打个比喻，如果说xAI是特斯拉，那么，OpenAI就是丰田，Anthropic就是沃尔沃。” 深圳某证券机构投资人孙骏告诉雷峰网。 “特斯拉强调性能、丰田主打全线覆盖、沃尔沃最重安全，跟这三款工具在打法上颇为相似。” 眼下，“三辆车”同时驶入同一个路口，油门踩到底，方向却不同，一场 AI 编程「三国杀」正式开打。 三巨头的终极愿景高度统一：实现全流程自动化编程，让 AI 独立完成写代码、修 Bug、项目部署，彻底重构开发者的工作方式。 三强同步亮剑，彻底终结了 “比拼谁更好用” 的浅层技术内卷，AI 编程赛道正式迈入锁生态、锁用户、锁终局的商业收网博弈时代，更多见地，欢迎添加作者微信 IHAVEAPLANB- 沟通交流。 xAI 走极致高价的精英路线，300 美元订阅费、封闭生态，用极致效率筛选顶级开发者；OpenAI 铺开全域生态战局，依托 GitHub、VS Code、API 三层体系全方位绑定工作流；Anthropic 深耕安全底色，为“AI工作出错如何追责”难题给出解法。 如今赛道的胜负手，早已不再是代码写得好坏，而是价格、生态、信任三套锁定策略的终极博弈。 谁的锁定能力更高一筹，谁就攥住了AI 编程的终局话语权。 效仿特斯拉，Grok Build专攻高端市场 “我目前用的是 Codex100美金的套餐，日常开发完全够用，所以暂时还没有升级到Grok Build的冲动。”前谷歌资深工程师唐溪柳告诉雷峰网，他目前没有更换AI编程工具的打算。 市面上类似的想法不在少数，毕竟开发者在选编程工具时，最看重的往往是两点：好不好用

excerpt_i18n.en: "In just four years, OpenAI has become a bureaucratic giant, while Anthropic still clings to its Effective Altruism faith, living like a religious sect. In Silicon Valley, everyone wants to scale up, but only they want to do what's 'right,'" Leo, a Silicon Valley AI venture investor, recently lamented to Leiphone. In the AI arena teeming with geniuses, the true life-or-death challenge for an AI giant has always been one thing: how to tame a group of highly ego-driven smart people. When these big-ego geniuses gather, they each hold their own "truths," from parameter fine-tuning to strategic direction. Without strong checks and balances, they are prone to walk out over ideological differences, causing the team to collapse. To stabilize them, a team consensus that transcends individual will must be established. "Currently, the only ones in the world capable of this are either led by a god-tier scientist like ChatGPT's father Ilya, or backed by the prestige of a veteran like Google AI chief Hassabis. Anthropic is the sole exception—it relies on faith, Effective Altruism, to make top geniuses follow devoutly like believers." At Anthropic, they don't compete over who has better technology, but over who can better build AI "firewalls" to save the world from AGI safety threats. For these geniuses, high salaries and stock options are standard; it's the messianic ideal of safeguarding humanity that proves irresistibly attractive.
excerpt_i18n.es: En solo cuatro años, OpenAI se ha burocratizado como una gran empresa, mientras que Anthropic sigue aferrada a la fe del altruismo efectivo, viviendo como una religión. En Silicon Valley, todos quieren hacerse grandes, solo ellos quieren hacer lo "correcto". Hace poco, Leo, inversor en startups de IA en Silicon Valley, comentó esto a Leiphone. En el campo de la IA, donde se agrupan genios, la verdadera clave de vida o muerte para un gigante de la IA siempre ha sido una sola cosa: cómo domar a un grupo de personas inteligentes con egos muy grandes. Cuando estos individuos se reúnen, desde ajustes de parámetros hasta decisiones de rumbo, cada uno tiene su propia "verdad". Sin un control firme...
